snippet.title: Frutiger Space: Meeple 2.0 Trailer
snippet.description:
Showcasing the newest addition to Frutiger Space: Meeples 2.0! 
They bring new customization options, as well as the ability to be more expressive through their eyes!
Music by @EgoSumAlibi
